# AlgoLearn – Circular Linked List Interactive Learning Platform

> An interactive educational platform dedicated to teaching the fundamentals, pointer structures, memory mechanics, algorithmic operations, and real-world implementations of the Circular Linked List data structure.

## Overview
- **Name:** AlgoLearn – Circular Linked List Learning Guide
- **Focus:** Computer Science, Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), Linked Lists, Pointer Mechanics
- **Target Audience:** Computer Science students, software engineering candidates, and developers mastering cyclic data structures and memory manipulation.
- **Access:** Free, web-based, interactive online educational curriculum.

## Public Curriculum Sections
1. **Overview / Home:** High-level summary of circular structures, cyclic workflows, and structural comparisons with singly linear linked lists.
2. **Theory & Field Notes (17 Chapters):**
   - Chapter 01: What is a Circular Linked List? (Definition, cyclic topology, memory structure)
   - Chapter 02: Node Structure & Pointer Mechanics (Data field, next pointer, absence of NULL termination)
   - Chapter 03: Singly Linear vs. Circular Linked List (Comparative architectural analysis)
   - Chapter 04: Head vs. Tail-Maintained Implementations (Why maintaining a Tail pointer enables O(1) prepend and append)
   - Chapter 05: Memory Allocation & Dynamic Pointer Wiring (Heap allocation and address references)
   - Chapter 06: Traversing a Circular Linked List (do-while patterns, termination guards, infinite loop hazards)
   - Chapter 07: Insertion at the Beginning (Step-by-step rewiring and pointer manipulation)
   - Chapter 08: Insertion at the End (Tail pointer updates vs. O(n) traversal)
   - Chapter 09: Insertion at a Specific Position (Boundary validation and link establishment)
   - Chapter 10: Deletion of the First Node (Updating HEAD, rewiring tail's next pointer)
   - Chapter 11: Deletion of the Last Node (Traversing to penultimate node and pointer closure)
   - Chapter 12: Deletion at a Specific Position (Pointer bypass and memory deallocation)
   - Chapter 13: Searching in a Circular Linked List (Linear scan with loop detection)
   - Chapter 14: Complete Code Implementations (C, Java, Python with line-by-line breakdown)
   - Chapter 15: Inherent Advantages of Circular Linked Lists (Cyclic access, no terminating NULLs)
   - Chapter 16: Disadvantages & Engineering Hazards (Risk of infinite loops, pointer complexity)
   - Chapter 17: Real-World Applications (Round-robin OS scheduling, multiplayer turn rotations, music playlists)
3. **Video Masterclass:** Curated walkthrough video tutorials covering introduction to circular linked lists and core pointer operations.
4. **Interactive Quest (5 Levels):** Gamified challenges testing circular connection building, traversal step prediction, head insertion, tail insertion, and pointer deletion.
5. **Interactive Lab / Workbench:** Visualizer with manual HEAD & TAIL address input, step-by-step execution, and live pointer rewiring inspection.
6. **Examination Quiz:** 10-question evaluation covering cyclic mechanics, time complexities, boundary cases, and pointer logic.
7. **Progress Ledger:** Granular mastery and milestone tracking with local persistence and full reset support.

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework:** React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite
- **Storage:** Local client-side progress tracking without external credential requirements.
- **Security:** CSP, HSTS, secure frame options, and strict privacy by design.
